title.en: Self-concern and C under the condition
title.zh: 条件之下之自关切与 C

statement.en: On a listing, self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide for every order exactly when each listed item is marked; with markings reading closures, for every standpoint, listing and order exactly where the condition holds de se. There it ranks each extension between listed level paths.
statement.zh: 于一固定列表，自关切与于接纳上递增对每一次序皆相合，恰在每一所列之项皆被标记时；标记读闭包时，对每一立场、列表与次序，恰在条件以从己方式成立处相合。彼处，接纳可判定时，自关切把二层径间之每一扩展皆排定，唯二径之所接纳容于一有限列表。

laws.en: On a listing, every order is increasing in its own continuation exactly when it is increasing in admission if and only if the marking marks every listed item: a listed item left unmarked gives a self-concerned order not increasing in admission. Read from standpoints, for any relation the markings read, the two coincide everywhere exactly where it holds of every standpoint and item.
laws.zh: 于一列表，每一次序于其自身延续上递增恰当其于接纳上递增，当且仅当标记标出每一所列之项：一所列而未标之项，给出一自关切而不于接纳上递增之次序。自诸立场读，对标记所读之任一关系，二者处处相合，恰当此关系于每一立场与项皆成。

laws.en: With each marking reading what the line under a class from the standpoint's center reaches along a relation, the two coincide everywhere exactly where the condition on the root holds; with it reading the center's closure along a relation, exactly where the condition held de se does. Near-definitional: the schema above at those readings. One half each: where it holds they coincide; an item outside parts them.
laws.zh: 各标记读自立场之中心于一类下沿一关系之线所及者，则二者处处相合，恰当根上之条件成立；读中心沿一关系之闭包，则恰当从己之延续条件成立。近乎定义：即上之模式于此等读法。各半：条件成立处二者相合；一在外之项使之分。

laws.en: With admission decided and what two level paths admit listed, an order increasing in admission ranks every extension between them, every claim counted as living; where the de se condition holds, so does an order increasing in the own continuation, each item marked by its formation. Listed paths admit nothing from some step on, and once there is a formation no list holds what every level path admits.
laws.zh: 接纳可判定，且二层径所接纳者已列，则于接纳上递增之次序把其间每一扩展皆排定，每一主张皆计为活；从己之条件成立处，于自身延续上递增之次序亦然，每项以其构成标之。所列之径自某步起无所接纳；一有构成，即无一列表含每一层径之所接纳。

laws.en: Along the net, self-concern and being increasing in admission coincide on the endless line of descent from its first birth, every later member failing the condition, and part on two family lines with no condition between them, whose first birth reaches exactly its own family; along the net's converse they coincide in descent that ends, from its last occurrence, and part on the endless line from every center.
laws.zh: 沿网，自关切与于接纳上递增于无尽传承之线自其初生相合，每一后来之员不满足条件；于其间无条件之二族线相分，其初生所及恰为己族；沿网之逆，于有终之传承自其末出现相合，于无尽之线自每一中心相分。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. A finite listing; two-valued admission; an order a relation on courses, not assumed complete or transitive; each standpoint's marking supplied, read as each law states (where a law uses one half of a reading, only that half).
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。有限之列表；二值之接纳；次序为进程上之关系，不设其完备或可传递；各立场之标记为所予，依各律所述读之（律只用读法之一半者，只此一半）。

hypotheses.en: Self-concern (Weighting.IncreasingInOwn) and the condition, on the root («续无外») or held de se (Unrestricted of the own closure), are hypotheses, self-concern derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence, and the condition varying with the net, the class and the direction; that a life forms such an order is not shown: what the models show of persisting is a filter on what was chosen, not an order formed.
hypotheses.zh: 自关切（Weighting.IncreasingInOwn）与条件，于根上（«续无外»）或从己持有（自身闭包之 Unrestricted），皆为假设：自关切不由任何动力学、选择或持存推出，且条件随网、类与方向而变；生命是否形成这种次序尚未表明：模型所显示的持续存在，只限定了哪些选择可能已经发生，并不表明作选择者持有或形成了某种次序。

hypotheses.en: For the ranking on a web: admission decided by a supplied two-valued reading, what both level paths admit listed as (step, formation) items, every claim counted as living, each item marked by the marking of its formation.
hypotheses.zh: 就网上之排序：接纳由所予之二值读法判定，二层径所接纳者列为（步，构成）之项，每一主张计为活，每项以其构成之标记标之。

hypotheses.en: It assumes self-concern and the condition held de se, admission decided and two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, courses whose admissions end; it concludes the extension rankings C asks between them, not the converse. Under activity, support and descent, where a line persists without end, the course actually taken fits no such list. The proof uses the condition only at the life's standpoint.
hypotheses.zh: 此结果以自关切与从己之延续条件为假设，接纳可判定，二层径所接纳之项容于一有限列表，即接纳有终之进程；它推出 C 在这两条层径之间所求的扩展排序，不推出其逆。在活动、支撑与传承之下，世系持存无尽时，实际所取之进程从不容于这样的列表（what-persisting-shows-of-an-order），此路于彼处无所言。证明只用到条件在该生命自身立场上的实例。

does_not_show.en: That C follows from self-concern on all of a web's level paths: the link holds between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, courses whose admissions end.
does_not_show.zh: C 于网之全部层径上自自关切得出：此联系唯于所接纳之项容于一有限列表的二层径间成立，即其接纳有终之进程。

does_not_show.en: The converse, that C on level paths makes an order increasing in admission on a listing: a course on a listing need not be what any level path admits.
does_not_show.zh: 其逆：层径上之 C 使列表上之次序于接纳上递增；列表上之进程未必为任一层径之所接纳。

does_not_show.en: That self-concern fails to rank an extension on a web where the condition fails: that half is proved on listings only.
does_not_show.zh: 条件不成处，自关切于网上不能排定一扩展：此半唯于列表上证之。

does_not_show.en: Any property of reach: the joins to the root are near-definitional, and locate where the two coincide.
does_not_show.zh: 所及之任一性质：与根之相接近乎定义，只指出二者相合之处。

does_not_show.en: That the condition holds, that a life forms such an order, that self-concern follows from any dynamics, or that C holds without its stated hypotheses: each is a hypothesis where used.
does_not_show.zh: 条件成立、生命形成这样的次序、自关切由某种动力学推出，或 C 无须所述假设便成立：各在用到之处为假设。

validation_scope.en: Pure core, every axiom report empty: the laws are in Becoming.PremiseWitnesses, a leaf importing GrammarCases, Lifting and EventualWideningInstances. The joins to the root compose withinClosure_iff_reached and ownClosure_unrestricted_iff_noOutside; the ranking composes Web.paths_extension_iff_widens and Web.widens_iff_every_weighting. Two AI reviews and a third look, every finding taken. The record's 19 declarations (19 theorems) compile with the whole package in the core run whose receipt the record binds.
validation_scope.zh: 纯核，公理报告皆空：诸律在 Becoming.PremiseWitnesses，引 GrammarCases、Lifting 与 EventualWideningInstances 之叶。与根之相接合成 withinClosure_iff_reached 与 ownClosure_unrestricted_iff_noOutside；排序经 paths_extension_iff_widens 等。此记录 19 声明（定理 19）与全包同编译于记录所系收据之核心运行。

next_delta.en: The other half on webs, where level paths admit the witness's courses; a bridge at a finite horizon for courses that admit something at every step; review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 网上之另一半，于层径接纳见证之进程处；于有限视界上为每步皆有所接纳之进程立桥；人之审查。

correspondence.en: A life's order over courses is self-concerned when it ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach, here the items its marking marks; going on alone does not give such an order. Being increasing in admission is a Pareto-style monotonicity that gives what C asks between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, and not the converse. Where one's own continuation marks everything, the two coincide, so there self-concern gives that too; on all of a web's level paths it gives nothing this way, and, under activity, support and descent, where a line persists without end, the course actually taken never fits such a list, so there this route is silent. The reading of where that holds, the condition on the root, is near-definitional and claims no property of reach.
correspondence.zh: 生命对诸进程的次序，若把扩大中凡增益其自身延续（读作其所及之内者，此处即其标记所标之项）者皆排在其所扩大者之上，即为自关切；单是继续下去并不给出这样的次序。于接纳上递增为帕累托式之单调，接纳可判定时，给出 C 于所接纳之项容于一有限列表的二层径间之所求，不给出其逆。自身延续标出一切处，二者相合，故于彼处自关切亦给出之；于网之全部层径上，此路不给出任何东西；在活动、支撑与传承之下，世系持存无尽时，实际所取之进程从不容于这样的列表，此路于彼处无所言。何处如此之读，即根上之条件，近乎定义，不主张所及之任何性质。

detail.en: Weighting.IncreasingInOwn, Weighting.AddsOwn and Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing, whose converse this record proves.
«续无外», withinClosure_iff_reached, ownClosure_unrestricted_iff_noOutside and ownClosure_unrestricted_iff, and the line of descent's models.
detail.zh: «续无外»、withinClosure_iff_reached、ownClosure_unrestricted_iff_noOutside 与 ownClosure_unrestricted_iff，及传承线之模型。

detail.en: Web.paths_extension_iff_widens, an extension on a web's level paths a widening of what is admitted.
detail.zh: Web.paths_extension_iff_widens：网之层径上之扩展即所接纳者之扩大。

detail.en: Web.ListsAdmitted, Web.DecidesAdmission, Web.stepBound and Web.lt_stepBound, with Web.widens_iff_every_weighting.
The nets on which the condition on the root holds and fails, which the fourth law reads for self-concern.
detail.zh: 根上之条件于其上成与不成之诸网，第四律就自关切读之。

detail.en: On a finite listing, widening is what every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero ranks higher; through it an order increasing in admission ranks every extension between two listed level paths, courses whose admissions end.
detail.zh: 在有限列表上，扩大即每一给每个所列之项大于零之权重的可加计法所排高者；经之，于接纳上递增之次序把二所列层径（接纳有终之进程）间之每一扩展皆排定。

detail.en: Mutual dependence gives the condition held de se along being affected, and the ranking here takes that condition for any relation on the same web: the two compose directly, though no single theorem states the composite.
detail.zh: 相互依赖给出沿被影响而从己持有之条件；此处之排序对同一网上任一关系取此条件为假设：二者直接组合，唯无单一定理陈述此组合。

history.en: 1 November 2026, board item DU (study section 489): added. Self-concern joined to the condition on the root and held de se, and one way to C between listed level paths, from Becoming.PremiseWitnesses; the vacuous form on every level path replaced at the third look by the pairwise one, its vacuity proved; every finding of the leaf's reviews taken.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日，工作板条目 DU（研究第 489 节）：增。自关切与根上之条件及自承之条件相接，并单向接于所列层径间之 C，出自 Becoming.PremiseWitnesses；于全部层径上之空真形于第三次复读时代以成对之形，其空真已证；此叶审阅所见皆取。

history.en: 7 November 2026, board item LM1: a reader of LM found the law on the nets named no center, and that this said C orders alone. The law now says the endless line coincides along the net from its first birth, every later member failing the condition, and descent that ends along the converse from its last occurrence, as the Lean states; a ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place (07 §4.4). No proof changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月7日，工作板条目 LM1：LM 之读者指出网上之律未言中心，且此处谓唯 C 定序。今言无尽之线沿网自其初生相合，每一后来之员不满足条件；有终之传承沿其逆自其末出现相合，如 Lean 所述；对进程的排序需要 C 或一个代替它的前提（07 §4.4）。证明不变。

history.en: 9 November 2026, board item WB: the ethics' framing re-said on Ren's words of 8–9 November 2026 (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-08-within-becoming-no-should.md): the two premises named as the readings the ranking results use, a ranking held by whoever ranks, no warrant from outside sought; no change to the claim, its hypotheses or its Lean.
history.zh: 2026年11月9日，工作板条目 WB：据 Ren 11 月 8–9 日之言重述伦理之框架：两个前提称为排序之果所用之两种读法，排序为排序者所持，不求外来之根据；主张、假设与 Lean 皆不变。

history.en: 9 November 2026, AG seventh pass (the sixth pass's two cold readings, on Ren's messages 9 to 12 of sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md): "courses that end" re-said as admissions that end; a hypothesis now adds that a life forms such an order is not shown, persisting being in the models a filter on what was chosen, not an order formed; that the proof uses the condition only at the life's own standpoint; widening said as what every additive positive weighting ranks higher on a finite listing; a related link says how the ranking composes with mutual dependence. No change to the claim's mathematics or its Lean.
history.zh: 2026年11月9日，AG 第七轮（据第六轮两份冷读，就 Ren 于 sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md 之第 9 至 12 条）：陈述中「有终之进程」改称接纳有终；一条假设增言：生命是否形成这种次序尚未表明，模型中的持存只是对所择者的过滤，不形成次序；言证明只用到条件在该生命自身立场上之实例；扩大改言为有限列表上每一正之可加权重所排高者；增一相关链接，言此排序如何与相互依赖合成。主张之数学与其 Lean 不变。

history.en: 10 November 2026, AG eighth pass: the statement says the quantifiers of the coincidence (for every order on a fixed listing, exactly when every listed item is marked; for every standpoint, listing and order, exactly where the condition holds de se); "one way" is no longer the label of the path result's direction (the converse is not shown); "for courses that go on forming without end it is not shown" is re-said as what is proved, that the course of a line persisting without end never fits such a list, so there this route is silent; de se is 从己 and the composition 组合 in Chinese. No change to the claim's mathematics or its Lean (on the seventh pass's two cold readings and Ren's messages 9 to 12, sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md).
history.zh: 2026年11月10日，AG 第八轮：陈述写明相合之量词（于一固定列表对每一次序，恰在每一所列之项皆被标记时；对每一立场、列表与次序，恰在条件以从己方式成立处）；路径之果之方向不再以「单向」标之（其逆未证）；「对无尽地形成下去的进程，未证」改言已证者：持存无尽之世系实际所取之进程从不容于这样的列表，此路于彼处无所言；de se 中文作从己，合成作组合。主张之数学与其 Lean 不变（据第七轮两份冷读与 Ren 之第 9 至 12 条，sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md）。

history.en: 10 November 2026, AG ninth pass: self-concern is defined in the correspondence by the sentence 07 and the fronts use ("ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach"); persisting is said as the fronts say it, a filter on what was chosen, not an order formed; the persisting course carries its hypotheses of activity, support and descent. No law or proof changed (on the eighth pass's critic and its Chinese round, sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md).
history.zh: 2026年11月10日，AG 第九轮：对应中以 07 与诸前页所用之句定义自关切（把扩大中凡增益其自身延续、读作其所及之内者，皆排在其所扩大者之上）；持存依诸前页之言：只限定哪些选择可能已发生，不表明持有或形成某种次序；持存之进程带其活动、支撑与传承之假设。诸律与证明不变（据第八轮评者及其中文一轮，sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md）。

history.en: 10 November 2026, AG ninth pass, last text round: the correspondence and the fourth hypothesis say the persisting line's limit of the course actually taken, the web's actual levels (Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted concludes ¬ W.ListsAdmitted items W.level), where they read "the course of a line that persists without end" and "a line persisting without end takes ... a course no such list holds". No law or proof changed (on the ninth pass's cold readings, sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md).
history.zh: 2026年11月10日，AG 第九轮最后一轮文字：对应与第四条假设中持存之世系的界限，就实际所取之进程而言，即网之实际层级（Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted 之结论为 ¬ W.ListsAdmitted items W.level），原作「持存无尽之世系实际所取之进程」。诸律与证明不变（据第九轮冷读，sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-11-09-agents-the-map.md）。
